name: Convergence W / C / L / A · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.37-block radius for 18 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 2.25 ❤ arcane + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s
• Light push
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
